name: PantryPal
one_liner: Snap a photo of your fridge, get 3 recipes.
problem: It can be difficult to figure out what to cook using only the ingredients already available in your fridge.
audience: Home cooks wanting quick meal ideas using ingredients on hand.

features.name: Ingredient Detection
features.description: Detects visible ingredients from a single photo of an open fridge.

features.name: Recipe Suggestions
features.description: Suggests three recipes ranked by how many of your detected ingredients they use.

features.name: Shopping List
features.description: Generates a shopping list for the few missing ingredients needed for recipes.

flow.text: The user opens the PantryPal home screen.
The user taps the camera button to open the camera view.
The user takes a photo of their open fridge.
The user views three suggested recipes ranked by ingredient overlap.
The user checks the shopping list for any missing ingredients.
